recipes.name: Thai Sweet Potato & Chickpea Green Curry
instructions: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Heat the oil in a large pot over high heat. Cook the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the curry paste, and mash into the garlic and onion mixture until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Then add the sweet potato, coconut milk, chickpeas, and water*.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, partially covered, until the sweet potatoes are cooked.
Remove from heat and add the spinach, stirring to wilt.
Serve over rice or with naan, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * Taste test after adding the water. Depending on how thick you like your curry, you may want to add more water to thin it out.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
